src: loose non-background pixels outside each same-colored solid 3x3 anchor block
path: straight horizontal, vertical, or diagonal ray from each loose pixel toward its anchor block, stopping at the cell just before the ray enters the anchor
trajectory: pack all loose pixels on the same ray into consecutive cells adjacent to the anchor, preserving their order by distance from the anchor
transform: keep the 3x3 anchor blocks fixed, erase the original loose pixels, and preserve each color's pixel count
